concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-risk-management-chargeback-guidelines-sepa-chargebacks]] — Adyen SEPA Direct Debit chargeback guide (webpage snapshot, 2026-09-15) for shopper initiation windows, non-defensibility, refund overlap, CHARGEBACK notification, and precautions.
warnings: The eight-week and thirteen-month periods describe different shopper dispute triggers, not a merchant defense window; the guide says SEPA has no dispute-management process.

The separate SEPA Auto Rescue source has qualified eligibility and attempt limits; this guide does not authorize universal chargeback retries. Its webhook JSON is a test example, not proof of every live payload field.
